mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, icon, builtin, user_id, sort_order FROM categories WHERE builtin = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT id, name, type, icon, builtin, user_id, sort_order FROM categories WHERE builtin = 1 OR user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, type, icon, builtin, user_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{icon}, #{builtin}, #{userId}, #{sortOrder})
